notes.title: Summer Development Update from Drinkbox Studios
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!


As you may know, we announced Blighted back in June as part of Summer Game Fest 2025 and Day of the Devs.  We’re honoured to have been included in those events, and we’re thrilled with the reception the game has received so far!



Since then, we’ve been hard at work…



We don’t want to spoil too much, buuuut we’ve recently added a TON of new enemies, and we’re still adding more. Each of them are deadly in their own weird and freaky little way...

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcGirw8Xgso8NdeflBw5tE3v9twKbLroA8soxm1P_mNAdGmdkZ5C9_bJyPOj2GZDyuTPcmwgHdYx6G8IqpUKWSmOjzHdpvdjUPkOhc04Oza7_x-x0lJfhnmYhKJKRH3fZxsfhy88A?key=ufPMY9caO1Pf00_ctoTGWQ"]

We actually also built out an early version of the entire game as part of an internal-alpha milestone! Now we’re in the process of tearing it up, choosing the best bits, adding new challenges and putting it all back together again.

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcB7WNc_ID7rJSXKc1JFCllZP1WG7931zeX0LzGzcbE39r41XNQEUhoFPC5fPW3r2ME0EwTgIr5yNacpA3YQVbiCgsbbN0d3VURjWpuC0UxvbzdqJl4Kz1GFr88HvST0So6Vln-3Q?key=ufPMY9caO1Pf00_ctoTGWQ"]

We still have a long way to go, and we’re working on many different aspects of the game, but we’re making steady progress.

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdS_wktGXW5cZQpDDjZt3wW6YyMfT8JOuDx3nTPCVZ09bmpu-1zeVOE7mKbCfz3RxLrI_0weblRZDYIhxJnt5lL6L0ZvElUxzM4LaMA6zo8hz-WDj0LxC1uAYI-FOXRAFfLqGL8vg?key=ufPMY9caO1Pf00_ctoTGWQ"]



We can’t wait to show you more!  If you’d like to follow along, check out the Blighted store page and wishlist the game. Thanks for all of your support, it means a lot to us.



The Drinkbox Team
